column1: Jake McCarthy leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a reliable track record, reaching safely in nearly three-quarters of his games and benefiting from a favorable platoon matchup against Merrill Kelly. Xavier Edwards also offers steady value near the top of the order, pairing a similar hit rate with a slight park boost and the platoon edge. Pete Crow-Armstrong and Bryan Reynolds are viable alternatives, but McCarthy’s consistency and matchup make him the most dependable option today.
